pass_a_gloss: After we, the Gentiles, know that we received the way of salvation through Israel's transgression and that they are cast out until our fullness comes in, and knowing that when the fullness of the Gentiles enters, then all Israel will be saved, we say first that the hills and the strength of the mountains were truly vanity, and second, concerning Israel after the fullness of the Gentiles, except that through our Lord God is the salvation of Israel; since we once recalled the apostolic saying that by Israel's transgression salvation came to the Gentiles, and when the fullness of the Gentiles enters, with Israel remaining outside, after the entering fullness of the Gentiles then all Israel will be saved, let us unfold these things: Israel was being saved, but the greater part of Israel fell, yet a remnant according to the election of grace has come to be, concerning which remnant it is mystically said in Elijah: 'I have left for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal'; and interpreting this remnant the apostle says: 'Or then also in the present time a remnant according to the election of grace has come to be'; therefore Israel, even if a remnant is being saved, having been left of Israel; these two groups, if you are able, transfer me also to the Gentiles; for he did not say: 'When all the Gentiles are saved, then all Israel will be saved,' but: 'When the fullness of the Gentiles enters, then not one of Israel will be saved after all the Gentiles, but after the fullness of the Gentiles'; if anyone is able, let the remainder, as he found Israel being saved after the fullness of the Gentiles, by passing through the word consider, when all will serve according to the things said above: 'to God under one yoke and from the ends of Ethiopia sacrifices'; when, as it is said in the sixty-seventh psalm: 'Ethiopia will hasten her hands to God', and to the kingdoms of the earth the word commands saying: 'Sing to the Lord, play music to the God of Jacob'.
